Recognizing the need for a spark, both managers turned to their benches. Hernan Lopez and Emiliano Viveros made way for Cesar Florentin and Matias Gimenez Rojas , while Argentinos Juniors introduced Facundo Bruera to bolster their attacking options. Despite these changes, the rhythm remained stop-start as both defenses held their ground with impressive composure. Resilient Defense Secures the Point As the clock ticked toward the final whistle, the game reached a crescendo of physical exertion. Gonzalo Maroni received a yellow card in the 80th minute before being substituted for Enzo Taborda as the coaching staff sought to shore up the midfield. The closing stages saw further strategic replacements, including the introduction of Nicolas Capraro to reinforce the defensive line during stoppage time. Despite the late pressure from both squads to find a decisive moment, the defenses reigned supreme. After four minutes of added time, the match concluded, leaving both teams to reflect on a hard-earned result built on discipline and tactical rigor.
